+def squareTerm (n : ℤ) : Module.End ℂ Fock :=

+/-- All signed indices are included; local finiteness is on the actual input state. -/
+theorem squareTerm_finite (v : Fock) :

+  have h : Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun n : ℤ => (c (-n)*c n) v) := by
